description: This file defines the LeavePeriodService class which manages leave period calculations, retrieval, and handling within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for generating leave periods, retrieving current periods, and related utilities.

classes.name: LeavePeriodService
classes.description: Service class responsible for managing leave periods including generation, retrieval, and normalization within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getLeavePeriodDao
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the LeavePeriodDao instance used for data access related to leave periods.

methods.name: getListOfMonths
methods.description: Returns an array of all month names in a year.

methods.name: getMonthNumberList
methods.description: Returns an array of numbers representing the months of the year.

methods.name: getListOfDates
methods.description: Returns an array of valid days for a given month, considering leap years.

methods.name: getCurrentLeavePeriodStartDateAndMonth
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent leave period start date and month, with an optional cache refresh.

methods.name: _getLeavePeriodHistoryList
methods.description: Fetches the list of leave period history records, cached internally.

methods.name: getGeneratedLeavePeriodList
methods.description: Generates a list of leave periods, optionally up to a specified date, and caches the result.

methods.name: getCurrentLeavePeriodByDate
methods.description: Finds the leave period that includes the specified date.

methods.name: getCurrentLeavePeriod
methods.description: Retrieves the current leave period if the leave period is defined.

methods.name: getNormalizedCurrentLeavePeriod
methods.description: Normalizes and returns the current leave period data suitable for external use.

methods.name: getMaxAllowedLeavePeriodEndDate
methods.description: Returns the maximum allowed end date for leave periods, if defined.
